title: Iconography / library overview

location.series: Jessie W. Lee / Verizon Master Brand Redesign

slide_intent: Inspect many symbols together so inconsistencies become visible before the library is used across channels.
strategic_value: A broad but coherent icon family can help Verizon explain many services without changing visual voice.
demonstration: A dense grid presents black outline icons for people, navigation, devices, security, shopping and other subjects on white.
practical_value: Scan repeated line weights, corner behavior and symbol density across the collection when reviewing additions.

content_islands.name: Icon matrix
content_islands.spec: Arrange equally spaced rows of small black icons across the white board, retaining the original order and generous space around each symbol.

reference_purposes.Expression: The grid demonstrates a large range of meanings in a consistent outline style.
reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying case study explains that the library was built to work across broadcast, digital and print.
